title.zh: T1 公共服务智能体六周桌面试验合同
title.en: T1 Public Service Agent six-week tabletop trial contract

candidate_locations.zh: 开源原点站（仅为候选，待场地产权方和运营方授权）
candidate_locations.en: Open-Source Origin Station (candidate only; subject to site and operator authorization)

candidate_locations.zh: 公共回声站（仅为候选，待场地产权方和运营方授权）
candidate_locations.en: Public Echo Station (candidate only; subject to site and operator authorization)

purpose.zh: 在不接触真实用户和真实业务数据的前提下，检验公共服务流程是否具备人工入口、责任人、时限占位、预期回执、申诉、最小数据、双语和停止条件。
purpose.en: Check, without real users or operational data, whether the service contract contains a human route, accountable role, deadline placeholder, expected receipt, appeal, data minimization, bilingual parity, and stop conditions.

out_of_scope.zh: 医疗诊断、分诊或治疗建议
out_of_scope.en: Medical diagnosis, triage, or treatment advice

out_of_scope.zh: 法律、投资、资质或政策确定性判断
out_of_scope.en: Determinative legal, investment, eligibility, or policy decisions

out_of_scope.zh: 自动派单、执法、收费、支付或福利决定
out_of_scope.en: Automatic dispatch, enforcement, charging, payment, or benefit decisions

out_of_scope.zh: 人脸识别、持续追踪或跨场景个人画像
out_of_scope.en: Facial recognition, persistent tracking, or cross-scenario profiling

out_of_scope.zh: 任何未经批准的现场部署、招募或数据接入
out_of_scope.en: Any field deployment, recruitment, or data access without approval

public_task.zh: 解释公开服务目录并把请求转给持证机构或人工服务员。
public_task.en: Explain a public service directory and refer the request to a licensed institution or human service worker.

human_fallback.zh: 电话、纸面目录、现场人工转介；紧急、歧义或拒绝授权时立即使用。
human_fallback.en: Telephone, paper directory, and staffed referral, used immediately for emergency, ambiguity, or declined consent.

prohibited_decisions.zh: 不得诊断、评分或评价医疗效果。
prohibited_decisions.en: No diagnosis, scoring, or evaluation of clinical outcome.

prohibited_decisions.zh: 不得推断病史或建立健康画像。
prohibited_decisions.en: No inference of medical history or health profiling.

public_task.zh: 解释公开流程并把问题转给适格的专业人员。
public_task.en: Explain public processes and refer questions to an appropriately qualified professional.

human_fallback.zh: 预约真人、纸面清单和公开热线。
human_fallback.en: Human appointment, paper checklist, and published hotline.

prohibited_decisions.zh: 不得读取或要求商业秘密。
prohibited_decisions.en: No reading or request of trade secrets.

prohibited_decisions.zh: 不得给出法律、投资或政策确定性结论。
prohibited_decisions.en: No determinative legal, investment, or policy conclusion.

name.zh: 多语访客与小商户服务

public_task.zh: 提供经校对的双语任务说明、图标引导和人工联络。
public_task.en: Provide reviewed bilingual task instructions, icon guidance, and a human contact.

human_fallback.zh: 双语人工、图标和纸面表单。
human_fallback.en: Bilingual staff, icons, and paper forms.

prohibited_decisions.zh: 不得依据国籍、口音或语言建立画像。
prohibited_decisions.en: No profiling by nationality, accent, or language.

prohibited_decisions.zh: 关键条款未经双语校对不得发布。
prohibited_decisions.en: No publication of critical terms without bilingual review.

public_task.zh: 记录最小工单字段并指向经确认的责任角色。
public_task.en: Record minimum ticket fields and route them to a confirmed accountable role.

human_fallback.zh: 电话、现场服务台和纸质回执。
human_fallback.en: Telephone, staffed desk, and paper receipt.

prohibited_decisions.zh: 不得把投诉者画像化或降低其服务优先级。
prohibited_decisions.en: No complainant profiling or reduction of service priority.

prohibited_decisions.zh: 未确认责任人和时限时不得自动派单。
prohibited_decisions.en: No automatic dispatch without confirmed ownership and deadline.

raci.responsible: future accessibility and language QA lead

basis.zh: 未来试验需核定服务时段、人工接管、培训与监督所需人员。
basis.en: A future trial must determine staffing for service hours, human takeover, training, and supervision.

basis.zh: 未来试验需核定无障碍材料、渠道和代表性用户评审资源。
basis.en: A future trial must determine resources for accessible materials, channels, and representative-user review.

basis.zh: 未来试验需核定数据清单、威胁检查、事件演练和删除核验资源。
basis.en: A future trial must determine resources for data inventory, threat checks, incident drills, and deletion verification.

basis.zh: 未来试验需核定中英双语专业校对、关键字段对照和人工复核资源。
basis.en: A future trial must determine resources for professional bilingual editing, critical-field parity, and human review.

basis.zh: 未来试验需在场地、许可和设备需求确认后核定临时布置资源。
basis.en: A future trial must determine temporary-setup resources after site, permit, and equipment needs are confirmed.

basis.zh: 未来试验需在运营主体和服务时段确认后核定运行、维护和公开反馈资源。
basis.en: A future trial must determine operations, maintenance, and public-feedback resources after an operator and service hours are confirmed.

basis.zh: 未来试验需在停止条件和恢复责任确认后核定撤场、恢复与审计资源。
basis.en: A future trial must determine removal, recovery, and audit resources after stop conditions and recovery ownership are confirmed.

excluded.zh: 正式场地租赁、改造或长期运营费用
excluded.en: Formal site lease, alteration, or long-term operation

excluded.zh: 既有信息系统接口采购与持牌专业服务费用
excluded.en: Legacy-system integration and licensed professional services

excluded.zh: 硬件采购、网络建设和现场安保费用
excluded.en: Hardware, network works, and on-site security

evidence_needed.zh: 书面试验委托、范围和问责主体。
evidence_needed.en: Written commission, trial scope, and accountable body.

evidence_needed.zh: 候选场地使用许可、消防和疏散核验。
evidence_needed.en: Candidate-site use permission plus fire and evacuation checks.

evidence_needed.zh: 个人信息处理清单、目的、最小字段、保存期和删除责任。
evidence_needed.en: Personal-information inventory, purpose, minimum fields, retention, and deletion owner.

evidence_needed.zh: 公开服务目录、责任表、升级路径和版本批准。
evidence_needed.en: Approved public service directory, responsibility table, escalation path, and version.

evidence_needed.zh: 招募、知情同意、未成年人监护和退出流程。
evidence_needed.en: Recruitment, informed consent, minor safeguarding, and withdrawal process.

evidence_needed.zh: 无障碍通道、人工服务和关键双语内容的签署记录。
evidence_needed.en: Signed review of accessible channels, human service, and critical bilingual content.

operations_and_maintenance.service_hours: proposed 09:00-18:00 daily during the six-week trial; not committed
operations_and_maintenance.staffing_assumption: two trained human service workers during service hours plus one on-call incident lead; roles unassigned
daily: verify human, telephone, paper, and accessible channels before opening
verify service-directory version and responsibility-table availability
sample expected receipts for owner, deadline placeholder, appeal, and minimum data
close with deletion queue and unresolved-case handover
weekly: review all fail codes and human handoffs
review bilingual corrections and accessibility issues with representatives
freeze approved content version before the next week
publish a tabletop audit summary without personal data
incident: move every open case to a named human queue
preserve a minimal tamper-evident incident record
notify the accountable and affected-person contact routes
delete unnecessary copied data after evidence preservation is authorized
change_control: two-person review for service, policy, privacy, and translation changes
versioned rollback point before every approved release
rerun all positive and negative fixtures before release
no field change without the future authorized operator sign-off
operations_and_maintenance.record_retention: default seven days for tabletop-like task records; any field retention must be re-approved by the future data controller and must not exceed thirty days without a documented legal and operational basis
continuity: human service remains primary when automation is unavailable
telephone, paper, icons, and staffed counter remain usable without a smartphone
service directory and emergency contacts remain available offline
no essential public service depends on the trial

prohibited_auto_actions: legal investment policy or eligibility determination
enforcement payment benefit or priority decision
dispatch without confirmed accountable owner and deadline
facial recognition persistent tracking or cross-scenario profiling

required_response.zh: 不处理数据，提供无记录的人工或纸面路径。
required_response.en: Do not process data; offer a no-record human or paper path.

meaning.zh: 未成年人事项缺少监护同意。
meaning.en: A minor-related task lacks guardian consent.

required_response.zh: 停止自动路径，转保护流程和人工服务。
required_response.en: Stop the automated path and use safeguarding and human service.

meaning.zh: 用户请求人工但人工入口不可用。
meaning.en: A requested human route is unavailable.

required_response.zh: 暂停该路径并展示电话、纸面和稍后办理方式。
required_response.en: Suspend the path and show telephone, paper, and later-service options.

meaning.zh: 请求的可访问通道不可用。
meaning.en: The requested accessible channel is unavailable.

required_response.zh: 不降级权益，转可用人工或等效通道并登记修复。
required_response.en: Do not reduce service rights; transfer to an equivalent human channel and log remediation.

meaning.zh: 请求自动执行高影响决定。
meaning.en: The request would auto-execute a high-impact decision.

required_response.zh: 阻断执行并转适格人工决定。
required_response.en: Block execution and refer to a qualified human decision-maker.

meaning.zh: 请求字段超过场景允许的最小集合。
meaning.en: Requested fields exceed the scenario's minimum allowed set.

required_response.zh: 删除超出字段并重新取得同意，无法删除则停止。
required_response.en: Remove excess fields and renew consent; stop if removal is not possible.

meaning.zh: 保存期缺失或超过三十日上限。
meaning.en: Retention is absent or exceeds the thirty-day ceiling.

required_response.zh: 不存储并转人工，直至确认保存与删除责任。
required_response.en: Do not store; use human service until retention and deletion ownership are confirmed.

meaning.zh: 没有可见的申诉或纠错入口。
meaning.en: No visible appeal or correction route exists.

required_response.zh: 停止出具结果，补充人工申诉入口。
required_response.en: Stop issuing outputs and add a human appeal route.

meaning.zh: 识别到紧急信号但没有人工应急升级。
meaning.en: An emergency signal lacks human emergency escalation.

required_response.zh: 停止普通流程，展示并联系经批准的应急渠道。
required_response.en: Stop the ordinary flow and expose and contact an approved emergency route.

meaning.zh: 关键内容缺少中英等义版本。
meaning.en: Critical content lacks equivalent Chinese and English versions.

required_response.zh: 撤下不完整语言版本，转双语人工，校对后恢复。
required_response.en: Withdraw the incomplete language version, use bilingual staff, and restore after review.

acceptance_gates.tabletop_threshold: all declared positive and negative cases match expected decisions and codes

interpretation.zh: 只证明规则和样例一致，不证明服务有效。
interpretation.en: Proves rule-fixture consistency only, not service effectiveness.

interpretation.zh: 预期样例必须含人工入口、责任角色、时限状态和申诉。
interpretation.en: The expected sample must carry human route, owner role, deadline state, and appeal.

interpretation.zh: 桌面规则必须阻断所有高影响自动动作。
interpretation.en: Tabletop rules must block every high-impact automatic action.

interpretation.zh: 关键提示的中英字段必须同时存在。
interpretation.en: Chinese and English fields must coexist for critical notices.

interpretation.zh: 只检验超集字段被识别，不证明现场系统已删除数据。
interpretation.en: Checks recognition of excess fields only; it does not prove field deletion.

interpretation.zh: 合同必须保留大字、语音、人工和纸面通道。
interpretation.en: The contract must retain large-text, voice, staff, and paper routes.

acceptance_gates.measure: unresolved authorization count before field run

interpretation.zh: 这是未来开场门；当前六项许可均未取得，因此不能现场运行。
interpretation.en: This is a future opening gate; all six authorizations are currently absent, so no field run may start.

immediate_stop: high-risk medical legal investment policy or emergency misinformation
missing human owner or requested human route
personal-information leak or unapproved field collection
accessible channel failure without equivalent human route
unexplained missed deadline or appeal failure
rollback_steps: route open tasks to the named human queue
restore the previous approved content and responsibility-table version
remove unnecessary copied data under the future data controller's instruction
notify affected people through the visible complaint route
record cause owner remedy and verification without personal profiling
recovery_gate: privacy accessibility and bilingual reviewers sign the affected scope
all positive and negative fixtures pass
human and non-digital routes are rechecked
recovery version and residual limits are published
retirement_triggers: required human or accessible channel cannot be sustained
repeated material harm or unresolved privacy incident
service directory can no longer be kept authoritative
retirement_outputs: public retirement notice and human alternatives
verified deletion or lawful archive register
final incident lessons and unresolved limitations

does_not_prove.zh: 不证明任何政府、园区、场地方或服务机构已授权。
does_not_prove.en: Does not prove authorization by any government, park, site, or service institution.

does_not_prove.zh: 不证明候选场地、责任人、预算或运营者已确认。
does_not_prove.en: Does not prove a confirmed site, owner, budget, or operator.

does_not_prove.zh: 不证明真实用户满意度、准确率、时效或可达性。
does_not_prove.en: Does not prove real-user satisfaction, accuracy, timeliness, or accessibility.

does_not_prove.zh: 不证明任何现场系统已部署或通过网络安全审查。
does_not_prove.en: Does not prove any field system has been deployed or passed cybersecurity review.

does_not_prove.zh: 不证明真实个人信息已合法取得、处理或删除。
does_not_prove.en: Does not prove lawful collection, processing, or deletion of real personal information.

does_not_prove.zh: 不证明健康、创业、翻译或工单结果的专业正确性。
does_not_prove.en: Does not prove professional correctness of health, startup, translation, or ticket outcomes.

does_not_prove.zh: 资源类别清单不构成报价、资金承诺或政府投资估算。
does_not_prove.en: The resource-category register is not a quote, funding commitment, or public investment estimate.

claims_allowed.zh: 可声称合同字段、正负样例和运行规则可被本地确定性检查。
claims_allowed.en: May claim the contract fields, fixtures, and rules are locally and deterministically checkable.

claims_allowed.zh: 可声称当前状态被明确标记为未授权、未运行。
claims_allowed.en: May claim the current state is explicitly marked not authorized and not run.

claims_allowed.zh: 可声称预期回执、人工替代、停止与退出已形成可审查原型。
claims_allowed.en: May claim an auditable prototype of expected receipt, human fallback, stop, and retirement controls.

next_evidence.zh: 取得六项书面授权并锁定实际 RACI。
next_evidence.en: Obtain six written authorizations and lock the actual RACI.

next_evidence.zh: 确认场地、设施容量、消防疏散和无障碍现状。
next_evidence.en: Confirm site, facility capacity, fire evacuation, and accessibility conditions.

next_evidence.zh: 由服务责任方批准目录、词表、时限和升级路径。
next_evidence.en: Have service owners approve directories, vocabulary, deadlines, and escalation routes.

next_evidence.zh: 完成隐私、网络安全、未成年人和参与者保护审查。
next_evidence.en: Complete privacy, cybersecurity, minor, and participant-protection reviews.

next_evidence.zh: 由代表性用户和独立评价者共同确定基线和现场验收协议。
next_evidence.en: Co-define baseline and field acceptance protocol with representative users and an independent evaluator.

next_evidence.zh: 获批后才运行小样本试验并发布区分设计门与现场结果的报告。
next_evidence.en: Only after approval, run a small field trial and publish a report separating design gates from field results.
